translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: ve dindiği zaman o geceye ki
translations.diyanet-isleri: Sükun erdiği zaman geceye and olsun ki
translations.clear-quran: and the night when it falls still
translations.pickthall: And by the night when it is stillest

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Rabbin sana veda etmedi ve darılmadı
translations.diyanet-isleri: Rabbin seni ne bıraktı ve ne de sana darıldı
translations.clear-quran: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺
translations.pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee

transliterations.easy: Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa
transliterations.scholarly: Mā Wadda`aka Rabbuka Wa Mā Qalá

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Ve kesinlikle senin için sonu önünden (ahiret dünyadan) daha hayırlıdır
translations.diyanet-isleri: Doğrusu ahiret senin için dünyadan daha hayırlıdır
translations.clear-quran: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one
translations.pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former

transliterations.scholarly: Wa Lal'ākhiratu Khayrun Laka Mina Al-'Ūlá

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: ileride Rabbin sana verecek de hoşnut olacaksın
translations.diyanet-isleri: Rabbin şüphesiz sana verecek ve sen de hoşnut olacaksın
translations.clear-quran: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased
translations.pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content

transliterations.easy: Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: O, seni bir yetim iken barındırmadı mı
translations.diyanet-isleri: Seni öksüz bulup da barındırmadı mı
translations.clear-quran: Did He not find you as an orphan then sheltered you
translations.pickthall: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)

transliterations.easy: Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Seni, yol bilmez iken (doğru) yola koymadı mı
translations.diyanet-isleri: Seni şaşırmış bulup, doğru yola eriştirmedi mi
translations.clear-quran: Did He not find you unguided then guided you
translations.pickthall: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)

transliterations.easy: Wa wa jadaka daal lan fahada

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Seni bir yoksul iken zengin etmedi mi
translations.clear-quran: And did He not find you needy then satisfied your needs
translations.pickthall: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Öyle ise, sakın yetime kahretme (onu horlama)
translations.diyanet-isleri: Öyleyse sakın öksüze kötü muamele etme
translations.clear-quran: So do not oppress the orphan

transliterations.easy: Fa am mal yateema fala taqhar

translations.diyanet-isleri: Ve sakın bir şey isteyeni azarlama
translations.pickthall: Therefor the beggar drive not away

transliterations.easy: Wa am mas saa-ila fala tanhar

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Fakat Rabbinin nimetini anlat da anlat
translations.clear-quran: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord
translations.pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse

transliterations.easy: Wa amma bi ni'mati rabbika fahad dith
